statement: A reviewed patch handed to the operator to sign can stop applying before they sign it. In a private sibling repository, main moved by one merged PR between review and hand-over. The operator's git apply then failed, and nothing on their side showed it: the tree stayed clean, no PR was opened, and the step was reported done. A review approves a patch against one base; it says nothing about whether the patch still applies at the tip the signer will use. Rules: when handing over a patch to sign, run git apply --check against the live origin/main tip and state that sha in the hand-over; after any rebase, treat the change as material and run both review passes again.
